publication.note: Tap commit pins vendor publication/checksum only; it is not the proprietary CLI source revision. No SPDX license claim for the binary is invented.

browserDependency.evidence: Module version and function symbols embedded in pinned ELF; Linux invokes first found xdg-open, x-www-browser, www-browser. Private xdg-open succeeds without launching a browser.

runtimeBlocker: Pinned proprietary CLI signin binds tcp :18000 (all interfaces) before browser login. Host-network execution cannot provide loopback-only callback isolation. Production qualification refuses live execution regardless of matching binary hash.

staticBinaryInspection.method: Source-only ELF Go pclntab function/type metadata and objdump disassembly; no binary execution or account access.
staticBinaryInspection.keyCreationFinding: No CreateApiKey RPC or API-key issuance was found in the inspected signin command/subroutine. OIDC session and optional SSO-user setup are distinct from the explicitly named api-key create. This is static evidence, not a live provider assertion.
staticBinaryInspection.browserHandoff: Cognito /logout with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, state; it can sign the browser out before the login.
staticBinaryInspection.listener: net.Listen("tcp", ":18000") with return URI http://localhost:18000. It is not a loopback-bound socket.
